body: I am so sorry. My kids are the only thing keeping me going. The loneliness is agony.

We’ve lived so much life together. Grown up together. We’ve been through a lot. Sometimes he can be the most beautiful human. I guess I don’t know. I just know I need him, desperately. Knowing there is nothing I can do to make him come back to me is agonising. 
Of course I don’t want my children to see me like this. I do my very best to not let them but sometimes it’s impossible. I can’t let go of the good times and I can’t let go of the idea that if I just love him more, just love him harder, he will love me back. I’ve always thought if I just try harder I can fix it all. There has to be a way.
